spec_match.rationale: Demonstrates the local-scheme rule — about:srcdoc inherits the embedder's policy container and is opted in implicitly — with a real srcdoc frame built under a requirement and real fetch probes inside it, including the response-origin re-resolution subtlety and the at-least-as-strict nesting rule in prose.

interactive.rationale: A rebuild button regenerates the srcdoc frame and runs both probes; readouts and verdict are driven by the frame's postMessage report of genuine fetch outcomes.

blurb_alignment.rationale: Index blurb promises a srcdoc frame under a requirement with connection probes and the nesting contrast; the page delivers all three.

edge_cases.rationale: Separates not-enforced (both probes ok), enforced (same-origin ok, cross-origin refused), and network-problem patterns; the cross-origin probe is deliberately button-gated so page load stays network-clean on restricted networks, with that choice labelled in the readout.

references.rationale: Links chromestatus.com/feature/5657801797009408, the explainer's local-scheme section, and the Chrome 148 worker-propagation sibling rather than duplicating it.

conformance.rationale: The suite's local-scheme-implicit-optin manual assertion names this page as its verification route — honest for an enforcement contract only observable on an origin-trial build.

runtime_evidence.rationale: Headless Chromium 141 with experimental flags via the repo CDP harness (no chrome-devtools-mcp in this cloud session): load ran the same-origin probe (ok, HTTP 200) with the cross-origin probe correctly reported as skipped; the button run connected both probes (opaque cross-origin response) and the verdict took the honest not-enforced branch; zero console errors, zero failed requests, 0px overflow; desktop screenshot read. Partial: the enforced pattern needs an origin-trial build.

telemetry_health.rationale: caee-srcdoc-probes-ran asserts the first full report; all fetch failures are caught into the report rather than leaking as unhandled rejections.

design_system.rationale: Design-system variables throughout; the srcdoc document's inline palette matches the framed-page convention at AA.

accessibility.rationale: Frame has a descriptive title, probe results live in a definition list, the verdict is aria-live=polite, and the rebuild button is a native 44px control.

mobile_desktop_parity.rationale: responsive-check matrix run for the feature id: mobile 360×740 DPR3 and desktop 1280×800, no horizontal overflow, console/network clean, both screenshots read.

openQuestions.title: Verify inherited enforcement on an origin-trial build
openQuestions.detail: On an enforcing build, confirm the srcdoc frame still loads, its same-origin probe succeeds (response-origin re-resolves to the embedder origin), and the cross-origin probe is refused with the allowlist console message.

guidanceConsulted.query: srcdoc iframe policy inheritance connection restrictions
guidanceConsulted.recommendation: Policy inheritance must be demonstrated with real inherited contexts, and bypass-looking shortcuts (local schemes) should be called out explicitly.
guidanceConsulted.appliedOrException: The page builds a genuine about:srcdoc context under the requirement and explains why non-inheritance would be a bypass; probes are real fetches reported from inside the inherited context.

guidanceConsulted.query: async probe results definition list live region
guidanceConsulted.recommendation: Report async outcomes as text in a single polite live region with stable labels.
guidanceConsulted.appliedOrException: Probe outcomes land in labelled dd cells and the one aria-live verdict; colors are never the only signal.

summary: Local-scheme inheritance: a srcdoc frame built under a connectionallowlist requirement running real same-origin and (button-gated) cross-origin fetch probes. Verified on headless Chromium 141 incl. experimental flags (repo CDP harness; no chrome-devtools-mcp in this cloud environment): honest not-enforced baseline with both probes connecting, clean console/network, 0px overflow both classes.
